summary: The selected companion fsgg.v3.selected-manifest/1 adds strict canonical ASCII JSON plus LF, bounded sorted regular-file member commitments and exact digest/count/checked-u64-total joins to the existing scalar selection. None requires absent bytes and supplies no independent census. Legacy wire/schema/vector bytes, scalar manifest DTO and supplier-journal /2 and /3 are unchanged; old digest-only originals cannot be implicitly upgraded. Validated values retain immutable fields and return fresh buffers. Both F# source tests and the maintained Python qualifier consume one immutable exact-byte corpus; runtime F# qualification and final protected acceptance must be read from native CI. Parsing is inert: no content existence, authentication, durable export, ACK, handoff, cleanup or installed host acceptance is established. The companion does not close V3-ENV-01, production custody/enrollment, receiver checkpoint or original unknown-effect holds.
title: Opt-in selected manifest validates exact member bytes without native authority
